short: Local length of the congruence module

statements.markdown: The congruence ideal is the kernel of T → y / ∈Z O (ccIdeal), and the local part of η j is the length of the corresponding congruence module, V Z ∩ (M + V Z c ) modulo M ∩ V Z for the lattice M of forms (etaLoc).

lean.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.ccIdeal
lean.plain: The ideal vanishing away from the selected eigensystems
lean.note: The product map evaluates at the eigensystems outside the lift subset. Its kernel is the ideal.
lean.fidelity_note: `ccIdeal` takes the kernel of the simultaneous evaluations outside the supplied finite set $Z$. The record's `cc` applies it to the full lift set.

lean.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.NData.etaLoc
lean.plain: Local length of the congruence module
lean.note: The local length is the length of the quotient of MtUp by MtLow.
lean.fidelity_note: `etaLoc` forms the two lattices using $Z_{\mathrm{good}}$ and its complement. The printed quotient uses $Z$ and its complement. Lean normalizes the length of the quotient by $\operatorname{length}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal O/\ell\mathcal O)$.
